name: MonarchAiKnowledgeScope
title: AiKnowledgeScope
wrapsNative: Toggle and Toggle(sources:isOn:) with .toggleStyle(.monarchCheckbox) in an indented VStack tree; Button for each group's disclosure
summary: A tree of spaces, documents and apps with checkboxes, where a person picks what grounds the assistant's answers.
whenToUse: Before or during a conversation, to let a person choose which spaces, documents and connected apps the assistant may search.
whenNotToUse: Not for what the assistant may do with a connector (use MonarchAiPermissionScope) and not for choosing one source (use a Picker).
api: init(_ sources: [MonarchAiKnowledgeSource], selection: Binding<[String]>, startsExpanded: Set<String> = [], showsSummary: Bool = true, labels: MonarchAiKnowledgeScopeLabels = MonarchAiKnowledgeScopeLabels())
struct MonarchAiKnowledgeSource { init(id: String, label: String, kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind, description: String? = nil, children: [MonarchAiKnowledgeSource] = []) }
enum MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind: String { case space, document = "doc", app }

struct MonarchAiKnowledgeScopeLabels { init(label: String? = nil, kind: ((MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind) -> String)? = nil, itemLabel: ((String, String) -> String)? = nil, summary: ((Int) -> String)? = nil, empty: String? = nil, expand: ((String) -> String)? = nil, collapse: ((String) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: sources
options.description: The sources as a tree: each has an id, a label, a kind (space, document, app), an optional description and optional children.

options.name: selection
options.description: The ids of the selected sources. A group's id stands for everything in it. Written after every change with every fully selected source, groups included, in tree order; ids not in the tree are kept at the end.

options.name: startsExpanded
options.description: The ids of the groups that start open.

options.name: showsSummary
options.description: Whether "3 sources selected" is shown under the tree. A fully selected group counts as one.

states.name: unchecked
states.description: Empty checkbox. Checking it selects the source and everything in it.

states.name: checked
states.description: Filled checkbox with a check mark. Checking it again clears the source and everything in it.

states.name: mixed
states.description: A group with some of its contents selected: filled checkbox with a dash. Checking it clears the group.

states.name: expanded
states.description: A group's chevron points down and its contents follow, indented one level.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With .disabled(true) the checkboxes take the disabled roles and cannot be changed; groups can still be opened.

states.name: empty
states.description: No sources: a small MonarchEmptyState reading "No sources available".

appearance: Each row is a Monarch checkbox with the label in the default text role and the description and kind in the muted text role; the chevron uses the subtle text role. Levels are indented by a spacing token. All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web builds an ARIA tree with a roving focus and arrow keys; iOS uses standard toggles in a column, so VoiceOver, Switch Control and a hardware keyboard move through them like any controls, and a group's disclosure is a separate button. Level, set size and position are not spoken on iOS. The web's Space and Enter shortcuts are the toggle's own activation. The web announces the summary politely; iOS shows it as text and lets each checkbox speak its new value. The web's controlled expanded and onExpandedChange are not offered; startsExpanded sets the first state. disabled is SwiftUI's .disabled(_:).
accessibility: The tree is a container named "Knowledge sources".
Each source is a checkbox (a standard Toggle through the Monarch checkbox style) named "Handbook, Space", whose value is on, off or mixed; the description is its hint.
A partly selected group is a standard mixed toggle, so its state is spoken, not only drawn as a dash.
Each group has a disclosure button named "Show contents of Handbook" or "Hide contents of Handbook".
Every checkbox and disclosure button has a 44-point touch target; labels and descriptions wrap at every text size.
The chevron uses forward and down symbols, so it points the right way in right-to-left layouts.
edgeCases: Checking a group selects every descendant; checking the last unchecked child of a group selects the group.
Selecting a group's id alone checks everything under it.
Ids in the selection that are not in the tree are kept, at the end.
A group whose parent is closed stays hidden even if it is in startsExpanded.
An empty tree shows the empty state and no summary.

examples.title: Choose sources
examples.template:
MonarchAiKnowledgeScope(
    [
        MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
            id: {{sources.0.id}},
            label: {{sources.0.label}},
            kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.0.kind}})!,
            description: {{sources.0.description}},
            children: [
                MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                    id: {{sources.0.children.0.id}},
                    label: {{sources.0.children.0.label}},
                    kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.0.children.0.kind}})!
                ),
                MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                    id: {{sources.0.children.1.id}},
                    label: {{sources.0.children.1.label}},
                    kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.0.children.1.kind}})!
                ),
                MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                    id: {{sources.0.children.2.id}},
                    label: {{sources.0.children.2.label}},
                    kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.0.children.2.kind}})!
                ),
            ]
        ),
        MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
            id: {{sources.1.id}},
            label: {{sources.1.label}},
            kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.1.kind}})!,
            children: [
                MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                    id: {{sources.1.children.0.id}},
                    label: {{sources.1.children.0.label}},
                    kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.1.children.0.kind}})!
                ),
                MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                    id: {{sources.1.children.1.id}},
                    label: {{sources.1.children.1.label}},
                    kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.1.children.1.kind}})!
                ),
            ]
        ),
        MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
            id: {{sources.2.id}},
            label: {{sources.2.label}},
            kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind(rawValue: {{sources.2.kind}})!,
            description: {{sources.2.description}}
        ),
    ],
    selection: $selection,
    startsExpanded: [{{expanded.0}}]
)
